mapper.select: SELECT V FROM APP_KV WHERE K = #{key} AND (EXPIRE_AT IS NULL OR EXPIRE_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: MERGE INTO APP_KV (K, V, EXPIRE_AT, UPDATED_AT) KEY (K) VALUES ( #{key}, #{value}, CASE WHEN #{expireSeconds} > 0 THEN DATEADD('SECOND', #{expireSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
UPDATE APP_KV SET EXPIRE_AT = CASE WHEN #{expireMinute} > 0 THEN DATEADD('SECOND', #{expireSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE K = #{key}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXPIRE_AT IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE DATEDIFF('SECOND', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, EXPIRE_AT) END AS MINUTES_REMAINING FROM APP_KV WHERE K = #{key}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM APP_KV WHERE EXPIRE_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRE_AT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
